# NekoTrail

> NekoTrail is a free, open-source (MIT) desktop app for macOS 13+ (Linux experimental) that runs Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and 13 more coding agents in parallel. Each task gets its own git worktree and branch, with a chat, diff, terminal, live preview and PR bar. Agents run through their own CLIs on the user's own logins: no account, no proxy, no telemetry. It imports repos, workspaces and chats from Conductor and is a free alternative to it.

Key facts:
- License: MIT. Price: free, no paid tier.
- Platforms: macOS 13 or later (Apple silicon and Intel, one DMG); Linux x86_64 .deb (experimental). No Windows.
- Agents: Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Goose, Qwen Code, Kimi, Auggie, Grok, Kiro, Droid, Mistral Vibe, Cline, Kilo.
- Conductor import: moves worktrees with git worktree move, checks branch, head commit and uncommitted files; deletes nothing.
- Source: https://github.com/Harshil-Jani/nekotrail
